scope: Saved-state diagnosis, not direct failure-particle identification or an admissible constitutive remedy. No replay/solver invoked.
signedGapInterpretation: geometric_gap=commanded_descent−actual_top_descent. Nominal geometric soil force=-epsilon*width*gap; positive force would pull soil upward. Native assembler uses predicted-corner increment, so these nominal individual forces are not the saved actual assembled per-contact tractions.
unsavedContactTraction: NOT_AVAILABLE: no statement that every unsaved substep/contact traction was compression-only
boundaryConclusion: No saved geometric spring is tensile and all saved total actual strip forces are downward/zero. A compression-only platen would change the declared boundary problem; saved evidence does not demonstrate persistent tensile strip force that it would simply remove. It cannot be claimed to cure the constitutive no-solution state.

stressReconstruction.method: For documented native isotropic Kirchhoff elasticity tau=lambda*tr(eps_el)*I+2G*eps_el and plane-shear symmetry: L=mean(tau_xx−2G eps_xx,tau_yy−2G eps_yy); eps_zz=L/lambda−eps_xx−eps_yy; tau_zz=L+2G eps_zz. Mean tau then uses all3 normal components.
stressReconstruction.directExportLimitation: VTK has sig_xx,sig_yy,sig_xy and eps_xx,eps_yy, not full sigma_zz/elastic_eps_zz. Reported3D mean is explicitly reconstructed; future direct stress/elastic-strain export would remove this inference.
stressReconstruction.thresholdScope: Floating-point diagnostic cut, not a tensile material cap or scientific-validation criterion

failureSignatureInference.method: Rank last-saved signed Ep by physical-tensor Frobenius distance to capsule committedEp; list actualJ differences separately. No weighted score or exact-ID attribution.
failureSignatureInference.reasonInferenceOnly: 212 updates separate last saved accepted update count19608 from failure-manifest19820; capsule carries no global particle ID or exact failure time. Other particles may evolve between frames.

nativeFailureReason: No admissible signed-tensor Soil2 solution; no apex clamp or irreversible maximum applied
historyGuardFailure: NOT_ESTABLISHED; capsule reason is no admissible signed-tensor solution
commandWorkAndSpringEnergy: These are different observations. Geometric saved spring energy is not exact assembled-contact work; neither proxy establishes closed energy balance or self-sustained sliding.
